name: emberbsd-user
description: Agent skills for EmberBSD users: applications, device diagnostics, personal Ports and GitHub workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Use EmberBSD devices and maintain your personal Ports.
interface.longDescription: Install and configure applications, diagnose devices, maintain personal source changes across upstream updates, and publish checked patches to the selected personal repository using available tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $emberbsd-user-guide to complete my EmberBSD user task and verify the result.
